business_process: Merchant help desk and terminal troubleshooting
description: Answer merchant calls and emails; troubleshoot terminals, gateway sign-ins, and deposits; escalate to the processor partner
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A merchant whose terminal or gateway fails cannot take cards; about 15 merchants call on a normal day. Merchants leave an ISO after one bad outage, and each merchant is worth about $1,300 a year in residuals. One business day without support is the most the Owner accepts
manual_workaround: Forward the main number to the support specialists' mobile phones (phone app); point merchants to the processor partner's 24x7 help line printed on each terminal
dependent_systems: SYS-05; SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-04; SYS-06; SYS-07
dependent_third_parties: Phone vendor; processor partner; suite vendor; internet provider; MSP
dependent_people_or_facilities: Merchant Support Lead; Merchant Support Specialist; office or home workspace

description: Take card details by phone from a merchant whose terminal is down and key the sale into the merchant's virtual terminal
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 160 keyed sales a month, worth little revenue to the company but valued by merchants. The company keeps no transaction data by design: sales are recorded by the gateway. The RPO covers only the ticket note. The service is in PCI DSS scope (P03)
manual_workaround: Merchant uses the gateway's own virtual terminal or mobile app, or the processor partner's voice authorization line
dependent_third_parties: Processor partner (gateway); phone vendor; internet provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Merchant Support Lead; Merchant Support Specialist

business_process: Gateway administration for online and virtual terminal merchants
description: Create and disable merchant gateway users; reset passwords; set up hosted payment pages; change merchant gateway settings
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 420 merchants depend on the gateway. A merchant locked out of its gateway account cannot refund or key sales; the processor partner can reset users as a fallback. Settings live in the gateway, so the company's RPO covers only its own change records
manual_workaround: Ask the processor partner's gateway support to reset merchant users; defer non-urgent setting changes
dependent_people_or_facilities: Terminal and Integration Technician; Merchant Support Lead

description: Collect applications and documents from merchants and outside agents; build the underwriting packet; submit it in the processor partner portal
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 25 new merchants a month. A delay of a few days postpones new residuals but does not affect live merchants. Applications hold owner Social Security numbers and bank details, so a loss of integrity or confidentiality matters more than downtime
manual_workaround: Hold applications in the CRM queue; agents keep paper applications in a sealed envelope until the CRM is back; submit later in the portal
dependent_third_parties: CRM vendor; processor partner; web hosting provider; outside sales agents

description: Order terminals from the processor partner; ship spare terminals to merchants with failed units; receive returned units
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A merchant without a working terminal falls back on keyed entry (BP-02) or the gateway app. The spare stock covers about 40 swaps. Inventory records sit in the suite
manual_workaround: Processor partner ships a replacement directly from its deployment center (next business day); merchant uses the gateway mobile app meanwhile
dependent_third_parties: Processor partner (deployment center, key injection); shipping carrier
dependent_people_or_facilities: Terminal and Integration Technician; office (locked cabinet)

description: Help merchants answer chargebacks and retrieval requests through the processor partner portal before network deadlines
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 40 disputes a month. Card network response windows are measured in days, so a 3-day outage risks lost disputes for merchants but no regulatory issue
manual_workaround: Merchants respond directly in the processor partner portal; the processor partner's dispute team grants extensions where the rules allow
dependent_people_or_facilities: Merchant Support Lead; Onboarding and Risk Specialist

business_process: Merchant risk monitoring and fraud filter settings
description: Review the processor partner's merchant risk alerts; adjust gateway fraud filter thresholds for e-commerce merchants (AI-001)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Merchant fraud or excessive chargebacks can cost the company under the ISO agreement's loss terms. Filter settings live in the gateway, so the RPO covers only the company's change log
manual_workaround: Processor partner's risk team holds suspicious merchant deposits; leave filter settings unchanged until access returns

business_process: Residuals, agent commissions, finance, and payroll
description: Reconcile monthly residual reports; pay agent commissions; accounting; biweekly payroll through the payroll service
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Residuals arrive monthly; commissions are paid monthly; payroll is biweekly and the payroll service can repeat the prior run. A 45-day cash reserve covers a delay
manual_workaround: Payroll service repeats the prior payroll; delay commission statements a few days
dependent_third_parties: Processor partner; payroll service; accounting SaaS

description: Pipeline tracking, pricing proposals, agent onboarding and offboarding, agent access requests
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Sales can pause for days with little loss. Agent offboarding must not pause, because a former agent's open access is a risk (P01 R-006)
manual_workaround: Track leads on paper; disable agent access through the Operations Manager directly in each system
